name: muninn
description: Muninn, Odin's raven of memory: your ai-memory in Codex. An app with this folder's memory (counts, the last handoff, recent pages), search and pages. Read-only.

interface.longDescription: Muninn reads your own ai-memory server (github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory) and shows the current folder's project: its pages, sessions and observations, the last handoff with its next steps, recent pages, a search across the project or every project, and any page as markdown. It only reads; capture stays with ai-memory's hooks.
defaultPrompt: Muninn: what does memory know about this project?
